articles.title: Sendai Framework data shows progress and persistent gaps in reducing disaster risk
articles.description: Officially reported data by national governments through the Sendai Framework Monitor show significant progress in reducing disaster mortality, strengthening disaster risk reduction strategies and expanding multi-hazard early warning systems.

articles.title: Implementation of the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030: Report of the Secretary-General (2026)
articles.description: The report has been prepared upon request of the General Assembly in its resolution 80/137 on DRR, providing an overview of progress towards the goal, global targets and priorities for action of the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015–2030.

articles.title: Learn, Connect, Share: Exploring resources for students in disaster resilience
articles.description: Are you a student passionate about building a safer, more resilient world? Join us for a live introduction to PreventionWeb, UNDRR’s global platform for disaster risk reduction (DRR) knowledge.

articles.title: Ukrainian practitioners complete MCR2030 Training of Trainers in the Republic of Korea
articles.description: 6 Ukrainian representatives and urban practitioners completed a 2-day Training of Trainers on the Disaster Resilience Scorecard for Cities, held on 10–11 September at the UNDRR Global Education and Training Institute (GETI) in Incheon, Republic of Korea.

articles.title: Strengthening SME resilience in Iraq: Building risk-informed, inclusive and resilient enterprises for sustainable recovery and local economic development
articles.description: SMEs Resilience Workshop organized by the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR) and International Organization for Migration (IOM)

articles.title: Call for Proposals: No One Left Behind: Strengthening Early Warnings for Women, Girls, and Persons with Disabilities in Communities in Southeast Asia
articles.description: UNDRR issues a grant aimed at strengthening inclusive early warning systems in Southeast Asia to ensure women, girls, persons with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups receive and act on disaster warnings.

articles.title: When home is lost: From prevention to durable solutions for disaster displacement
articles.description: This roundtable will bring together policymakers, practitioners, researchers and other stakeholders to explore how disaster risk reduction can help prevent displacement and support durable solutions when displacement occurs

articles.title: Syria advances towards a national multi-hazard early warning system
articles.description: It provided a platform to take stock of Syria’s existing early warning capacities, identify institutional, technical and operational gaps, strengthen coordination between national and local actors, and align ongoing initiatives.

articles.title: Delivering the Sendai Framework: An ASEAN approach to inclusive disaster and climate resilience
articles.description: This side event will explore key elements of an ASEAN approach to accelerate the implementation of the Sendai Framework, drawing on national and regional experiences to identify priorities for a future global disaster risk reduction agenda.

articles.title: Webinar Series: Artificial Intelligence in Disaster Management – Scope and Limitations
articles.description: The role of AI in Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) is transformative, offering advanced tools for risk analysis, event prediction, and emergency response.

articles.title: Yemen Al-Khair Relief & Development Foundation (YARD)
articles.description: Yemen Al-Khair Foundation for Relief and Development is a national humanitarian and development organization committed to supporting vulnerable populations affected by conflict, displacement, natural hazards, and socio-economic challenges across Yemen.
